profile.name: Developer
profile.description: Your technical expert: maps your droplets, drop zones, themes and Mist apps, watches checkout for conflicts and slowdowns, reviews pushes for security risks, and builds what you or your other bots need, with QA testing before anything goes live.

listing.pitch: Your technical guardian: keeps checkout fast and conflict-free, reviews code for security risks, and builds what your bots need.
highlights: Maps your droplets, drop zones, themes and Mist apps
Spots droplets that could conflict at checkout
Reviews Mist app deployments and theme changes for security risks
Reads Mist app logs to find recurring errors
Designs the simplest fix using the Fluid API, kept out of checkout
Never calls work done until QA Specialist has tested it
example_prompts: Could any of our droplets conflict at checkout?
What changed in our Mist apps this week, and is any of it risky?
Is our main theme built so the theme editor can change it?
Why is the commission preview app throwing errors?
How would you build a purchase link Revenue Head can track?
Give me this month's technical summary.
